notes.title: Secret Government update is now available on beta branch!
notes.notes:
Greetings Brethren!

After more time spent meditating and decrypting the ancient texts, we have prepared another update for Secret Government! This patch brings in so many different changes, fixes and additions that we'd like to spend some more time testing it and get more eyes on it too - we are already satisfied enough with the current state of it, that we'd like to allow you to play it as well.

Here are the instructions on how to switch to the latest version:
Go into your library, right-click Secret Government and select the "Properties" option.
In here, choose the "Betas" option
You should be able to choose a "beta - Secret Government open beta" beta from the drop-down menu above.
In your Steam library the Secret Government should now have [beta] tag behind it, which means that you are playing the beta branch.

If you run into any kind of bugs or issues, please report it using the CTRL+F11 bug reporting function or head over to our Steam Forums and let us know there.

As always, here is a huge THANK YOU to all members of our brotherhood who help us improve the game, by posting feedback and bug reports into our Steam forums - Thank you! ❤️

Major Update for Secret Government Released
notes.notes:
Greetings shadowy leaders,
It has been some time since the last update, but rest assured, we have not forgotten about the game. We have heard all the voices asking for a simplification of many gameplay and UI aspects and other various feedback. And we have prepared a major update changing many of these things.

Key features of the update:

 In-game resources system is simplified
 New system of recruitment is introduced
 Brothers' traits system is reworked
 The Brotherhood greatness is introduced
 Tutorials are reworked completely
 Title-specific errands are introduced
 The Brotherhood goal system has appeared
 Ideas spreading system is changed
 The Dark Brotherhood behaviour is reworked
 Trends are introduced


Unfortunately, due to the complexity of the changes, this will make the new version of the game incompatible with older save files. Any player who wishes to access the original game build can do so by activating the beta branch called "beta" (right-click on the game in your library, select "properties" and then "beta", from the drop-down menu of "Select the beta you would like to opt into" select "beta").

notes.title: Tutorials update
notes.notes:
Greetings to you, Grand Masters and leaders of Secret Societies! In this short article, our team would like to tell you the news about our game. Some time ago we developed a major update of the tutorial mode. Such a comprehensive and complex game as Secret Government can be quite difficult for a player in terms of the game mechanics, although lots of players enjoy the process of getting to know the game. However, we’ve walked the extra mile to make the tutorial mode easy and accessible.

After we developed the new update, we decided to test it not only within our team but also to attract a small group of players for a beta test. When we did the test, we realized what kind of problems the players face during the tutorial. First of all, it turned out to be too long, so that the players could get too far away from the actual game. Creating and developing your secret society in the game is much more fun than going through long-term tutorials. Taking into account this important detail, we decided to finalize the tutorial.

The team is currently working on the next update. First of all, we revised the duration of the tutorial mode for some chapters and made it shorter. The player now has the opportunity to start a tutorial at any time during the game. It allows you to study particular game mechanics almost without breaking away from the gameplay. We hope that these updates will help new players get into the game better, as well as allow more experienced players to refresh their memory on certain game mechanics.
Now we are also working on various bug fixes and interface improvements.

We are always glad to hear your comments and ideas that you can bring to us on social networks or our discord. See you again in the world of conspiracy theories!

notes.title: Upcoming changes in the updates
notes.notes:
Introduction
The upcoming game update will greatly change many of the core mechanics. We decided to describe some of the changes in this short article so that our current players won’t feel completely lost when we launch the update.


Brotherhood Ideology
Now the Brotherhood and all its supporters follow the ideology that the player chooses at the start of the game. This ideology determines how the Brothers want to see the world, their goals and methods to achieve them. The more this ideology is shared around the world, the easier it is for the Brotherhood to find supporters and gain resources for the operational activities.

Brotherhood Resources
The resource system is getting really simple. Now it consists of only two types: the global resource of the Brotherhood and the local influence in a particular country.
The local influence is required for neophytes and adepts to run errands within the country, change its laws, oppress certain population groups, and so on. They can also gain this influence for the Brotherhood, but only in the country in which they are located. You can’t transfer a local resource from one country to another, you will have to gain influence in new lands from scratch.
The global resource is required for Masters to run errands of the Brotherhood per se. For example, it is spent on attracting new supporters. You can get this resource by using Lodges in case the ideas of the Brotherhood are widespread enough in the country.

Brotherhood Greatness
Whether it’s a member of the Brotherhood or just a civil servant, everyone has a personal influence parameter. For civil servants, personal influence strongly depends on the power and level of the country as well as the position held by the servant. For the Masters of the Brotherhood, it depends on their experience and the general greatness of the Brotherhood.
If the level of the Master's personal influence is far below the level of the influence of a minister of trade, it’ll be difficult even to get an appointment with this minister, let alone convince him of the ideas of the Brotherhood.
The more influential countries find themselves in the webs of intrigue woven by the Brotherhood, the greater the personal influence bonus each of its members will receive.

Spreading Ideas
Spreading the ideology of the Brotherhood will now become a much more interesting and complex task. The ideological pressure errand is no longer available, yet all supporters of the Brotherhood passively spread the ideology at their location. Political forces and estates create the heaviest political pressure while different segments of the population have their own preferences. Aristocrats, for example, are much more willing to accept the ideas of Feudalism or Absolutism than Socialism or Liberalism.

Rite of Passage
From now on, you can’t get a new Master by simply dragging a neophyte to an empty slot. Several conditions need to be met before the Worshipful Master can conduct an initiation ceremony. He is the only Master who has the right to do it.
If for some reason the Brotherhood loses the Worshipful Master, then any of the remaining Masters can perform the rite of initiation and take his place.
The loss of all six masters means the end of the Brotherhood.

Changing Traits
Almost all of the traits have been redesigned and rebalanced to have higher importance and coherence with the gameplay. There are a lot of new traits that make a character build more meaningful when leveling up a brother.

Master’s Specialty
Masters will have their specialty. From now on, only the Worshipful Master will be able to create new Lodges. Tyler will make assassination attempts and interrogate prisoners. Orator will be able to increase the loyalty of supporters and undermine that of everyone else. Also, Masters will have a number of unique features, depending on their title.

Ideology and its influence
Ideology is the idea that people have about how society and the world around them function. If you change the ideological pattern in people’s heads, they themselves will change the world according to the new pattern. The dominant ideology in the region determines which estates are desirable and which are unacceptable; what powers and rights certain segments of society have. The ideology shared by a political force determines what forms of government will be available if this force takes power. The form of government, in turn, determines the legal restrictions that can be established on the territory of the country.

The population’s demand for the particular ruling political force also depends on the adopted ideology. In addition to the basic needs of livelihood, people want specific needs to be met as well. Nationalists want people of the same nationality to live next to them, Liberalists want strict compliance with the laws by all segments of society, Egalitarians want universal equality in rights. The support for the ruling political force by the population depends on whether these needs are met or not.

As a result, the entire image of society in a certain territory is determined by the ideology in the minds of representatives of this very society.

Brotherhood Support
Ideas are the Brotherhood's main weapon for transforming the world. After choosing a particular ideology as an example of a perfect world to live in, the Brotherhood shares it with every neophyte. The members of the Brotherhood consider it their duty to spread bright ideas wherever possible. Each Brother creates ideological pressure in his country, which slowly puts the necessary ideas in the minds of ordinary people.

The chosen ideology sets a certain range of criteria. They determine how close the society is to the condition that the Brotherhood wants. The closer the society is to the desired condition, the easier it is for the Brotherhood to find support among the population and gain resources to achieve their goals.

To get a reliable Brotherhood outpost in any country, it’s necessary to recruit at least 30% of government employees into the Brotherhood and complete at least a part of the ideological criteria. You’ll also need to establish a lodge with the help of which the Brotherhood will collect resources for its further expansion.

The Spread of Ideology
Ideology spreads due to ideological pressure created in a number of ways. The stronger the pressure, the more people will share this ideology.

The sources of the ideological pressure can be:
Members of the Brotherhood: neophytes, adepts, and masters. Please note that the strength of the pressure created by an adept depends on the importance of the post he holds in the government, and the strength of a master depends on his level.
Political forces that regularly canvass the population. Surely, the public force has more opportunities for agitation than the secret one.
Some estates themselves spread the ideology that they share. A clear example is the Intellectuals.
By trading with a neighboring region, the population can pick up new trends or make sure that the neighbors share the same views.

People, however, are not ready to accept any ideology so easily. For example, the Aristocrats are much more impressed by the ideas of Feudalism than Socialism, otherwise, they lose their privileged status. So different estates prefer some ideologies and reject others, which affects the way the ideological pressure can be effective.

notes.title: Announcement: Slight delay in Content Update Launch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633856/4b3fadd598caf776eebb13aabdf5b9f76d818968.png

Brethren,

If you’ve been following our public roadmap, you know that we were due to launch our next major content update today, December 15th.

Regretfully, we’re going to have to push the release back by a few days. Here’s why:

As with every release, our goal is to give you a better version of the game by fixing bugs and improving gameplay mechanics based on your feedback. That said, the world of coding is as treacherous as that of any secret society. Sometimes, solutions that appear simple, turn out to be convoluted and bear unforeseen challenges.

And that’s exactly what happened with this release.

You already know we’re a tiny team. But to us, that’s no excuse for putting out a sub-par release, even if we’re still in Early Access. That’s why we’ve decided to hold back on the release and put a little more work into it, so that it meets our (and more importantly, your) expectations.

On a final note, the official release date of the game has been updated to April 8th, 2021.

We apologize for keeping you waiting, and thank you for your continued patience and support.

Glory to the Brotherhood!

The Secret Government Team

P.S. Did you know we’ve made it into the Top 100 of IndieDB’s Indie of the Year 2020? If you’d like to help Secret Government, please take a moment to vote for it here: https://www.indiedb.com/games/secret-government

It would mean the world to us. Thank you!

notes.title: New beta version available
notes.notes:
We have updated the beta version of the game. During last iteration, the main task was to demonstrate the future game model, based on already existing mechanics.

A new game loop scheme has been developed:
• the player performs quests and infiltrates into the institutions to earn domination points
• the player invests points in the selected research
• research opens up policies for use by countries and affects other mechanics
• the policies adopted by countries and the actions performed by the player (through the mechanics) influence the values of the classes and their support of the ruling and opposition parties
• at a certain ratio of support to the ruling and opposition parties, the player can make a revolution and change the political system in the country (which is the purpose of the mission in the current plot mode)
• data on the situation in the world is shown to the player (which may be the purpose of a mission in the free mode (free mode has not yet been implemented))

What is included in the version:
• The tree of ideas: the tree of ideas that are in the air, the study of ideas, the discovery of new actions, quests, political regimes.
• The mechanism of values and needs of different classes of society: the relationship of significance and satisfaction of the values of classes with party policies, the influence of various game mechanics on modifiers to the level of satisfaction of values, the ability for the player to influence them by performing actions
• Game mechanics updates and additions in connection with the mechanism of values and policies: the ability to influence the level of mobilization, the allowances of the military, the volume of trade, etc. calculation of public order mechanism change
• Creation of the policy change algorithm in the country and the dependence of the country's AI logic on the policies chosen by the ruling party
• The output of information in the window of the world about the current relationship in the world of policies in states and values.

notes.title: New beta version available
notes.notes:
Today we have updated the beta version of the game. We are already very close to the final, but we still have a lot of work to do!
We request those who are already involved in beta testing to play the game and leave your feedback! The game has changed dramatically in comparison with previous versions. Those who are ready to take part in playtests please contact us via the community message, we will provide the keys.

Here is the list of new featuresin this version:
0. The long-awaited saving of the game.
1. The player has now an antagonist - The Other Brotherhood. It has the same goals and objectives, it competes with you. AI (artificial intelligence) plays for The Other Brotherhood.
2. The country has an AI government. The government improves the welfare of the country by entering into military and trade unions, changing taxation and strength of the armies. The government ensures that no unrest begins in the country, and therefore does not take unpopular decisions, on the contrary it tries to get the support of the population. In the event of an unfavorable domestic political situation it tries to stabilize it.
3. In each country, the Brotherhood has agents who inform the player about the actions of the government and the Other Brotherhood. The actions of the Government and the Other Brotherhood can both interfere with the player or be useful.
4. The Great French Revolution plot mission returned to the game. It contains historical and plot events. The goal of the mission is now not only in the set of points on the victory scales, but also the passage of the plot.
5. Updated soundtrack and sounds in the game.
6. Numerous interface improvements
7. Bugfix and stabilizationtion

notes.title: New beta version available
notes.notes:
Friends, we have published a new beta version of the Secret Government game. We set a goal to make the game more interesting without adding new mechanics and it seems we did it.

Here is what has changed in the new version:
1. A "web of influence" appeared on the map. It shows how much you control the countries and how your secret government is distributed on the map.
2. Information icons appeared on the main map and in the filters. They are displayed when any parameters change in the game, either by themselves or thanks to you. Implemented for changing relations between countries and awareness of the activities of fraternity.
3. The game has pop-up notifications that inform about the completion of some part of the quest, the appearance of new quests on the map.
4. Improved usability of the action selection interface. Now you need less clicks.
5. Added new quests on the mechanics of relationships / alliances / wars to make the game more diverse.
6. On the map edded icons of intrusion to institutes.
7. There are a lot of improvements in the mechanics of war, alliances and the whole game.

Known issues:
- Impossible quests may fall out
